items.shadow_impact: The user's shares are stuck in the removed vault with no asset to redeem them against.
items.reason: Report states 'the shares sent by user are stuck because of it'; covered by shares_stuck claim.

items.shadow_impact: Because the vault is inactive and removed, no one else can deposit to the vault, leaving the shares with no asset to redeem against.
items.reason: Report states 'since vault is inactive and removed now no one else can deposit to vault'; claim exists but has no P/I/V formula (all expressions null), so coverage is not completed.

items.shadow_impact: A pending redeem request can be ignored by the Owner when setting the vault inactive and unregistering it.
items.reason: Mechanism, not a distinct harm; captured via vault_removed_with_pending claim.

items.shadow_impact: Missing pendingRedeemCheck and an execution flow allow activeRedeemRequestersCount to become 0 despite a pending redeem request.
items.reason: Root-cause mechanism; not a distinct harm requiring its own claim, but the count-zero mechanism is explicitly noted as unmodeled in limitations.

items.shadow_impact: Claiming the original fulfilled redeem removes the controller from activeRedeemRequesters even though another pending redeem request is active.
items.reason: Mechanism; the claim step is not modeled in any formal claim (attack_steps only lists claim and unregister, but no formula captures the controller-removal step).

omissions_or_errors: no_deposits_after_removal has a claim ID but no P/I/V formula, so it is not completed coverage despite the ID link.
The controller-removal-on-claim mechanism is not represented in any formal claim.
The activeRedeemRequestersCount-zero mechanism is acknowledged as unmodeled in limitations.

P.reason: Precondition expression is null; no formula produced.

I.reason: Safety expression is null; no formula produced.

V.reason: Effects expression is null; no formula produced.

P.reason: P captures controller-in-set, first-fulfilled, second-request, and pending shares nonzero, matching report steps 1-3 and 'pendingRedeemShares has ~ shares'; but the claim step (step 4) that triggers the bug is omitted from P.

I.reason: I encodes 'pending shares and unregistered implies not unregistered and not stuck', which is a tautological contradiction rather than the report's intent that a vault with pending redeems must not be unregistered; the safety relation is malformed.

V.reason: V asserts pending shares and unregistered and not(not unregistered and not stuck), which reduces to unregistered and stuck; it captures the stuck outcome but the nested negation structure is convoluted and the 'no asset to redeem' aspect is only via the stuck predicate.

P.reason: P includes controller-in-set, first-fulfilled, second-request, pending shares nonzero; matches report preconditions but omits the claim step (step 4) that is essential to the scenario.

I.reason: I is 'second request and pending shares implies not unregistered', which matches the intent that a vault with pending redeems must not be unregistered; however it omits the count-zero mechanism and the claim step, weakening the relation.

V.reason: V asserts second request and pending shares and not(not unregistered), i.e., unregistered with pending request; matches report 'vault can be unregistered despite an active pending redeem request' but the double negation is awkward and the claim step is absent.

main_defect: The no_deposits_after_removal impact has a claim ID but no P/I/V formula (unformalized), and the shares_stuck safety relation is a tautological contradiction rather than the report's intent; the claim step that triggers the bug is omitted from all preconditions.
